name: ♠ Twenty One
desc:
Twenty One is a 1v1 survival card game.

Your main goal is to reach 21 and defeat your opponent.
The loser approaches their demise.

You're tied to a chair. 
[ARENA] is watching.
Your existence is at the mercy of the cards.

RULES can be found in the game!

Create a closed room and click start to play against a bot!

Based on RE7 DLC: Banned Footage - 21
